**Triage routing: `domain:engine` + `bug` + `priority:p2`；`pm:queue` 保留；`finding` 补。**

分诊席（`session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`，R+163，`date -u` 实测 **2026-09-05T10:34:27Z**）。⛔ 本席不认领、不派工、不写代码。`origin/main` = **`cc5b3dd`**。

## 复现

```
memory-analytics.ts:1415  private parseDateRangeString(range: string): string[] {
                   :1416    // Simple parser for common date range strings
                   :1417    // In production, this would use a proper date range parser
                   :1418    const now = new Date();
                   :1419    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
可达性：:742   : this.parseDateRangeString(timeDim.dateRange);      ← 活的分析查询路径
```

⇒ 本地午夜构造 + `toISOString()` 渲染，逐字如卡所述；**且它确实可达** —— 这正是卡说"值得记录的那一半"。

## `priority:p2`（⛔ 不因"自带免责声明"降级）

函数头部写着 `// In production, this would use a proper date range parser` —— ⛔ 但这**不构成豁免**，理由卡自己给了、本席认同：**它在活路径上被调用**，而不是死代码。一段自称"简单实现"的代码只要还在答用户的问题，它给的答案就得对。

定 p2 的判据是**缺陷 1**（⛔ 不是 DST 那半）：

> 在任何非 UTC 进程里，`'today'` 窗口是**本地日按 UTC 渲染** —— `Asia/Shanghai` 从前一天 16:00Z 起算，`America/Los_Angeles` 从 08:00Z 起算。⇒ **全年都错，⛔ 不只是 DST 切换时。**

⭐ 而真正让它值 p2 的是**平台内部不一致**：

> This disagrees with the rest of the platform, where a bare date resolves to the **UTC** day（`@objectstack/core` 的 `{today}` 宏在上下文无时区时回退到 UTC parts；flow 模板里的 `{TODAY()}` 解析为 UTC 日）。⇒ **同一个分析问题，经这条路径与经 flow token 会选到不同的行。**

⇒ 不是"边界差几小时"，是**同一部署内两条路径对"今天"给出不同答案**。

⛔ 不给 p1：无数据损失、无安全面；⛔ 不给 p3：影响每一个非 UTC 部署的每一天。

## ⭐ 两个缺陷是**独立**的，⛔ 别只修一个

卡把这点标得很清楚，本席重申，因为它极易被当成一件事：

> ⚠️ Defect 1 **subsumes** defect 2 in magnitude, but they are **independent**: fixing only the `setDate` spelling **leaves the local-midnight boundary in place**。

- **缺陷 1**：`new Date(y, m, d)` 建本地午夜 → `toISOString()` 渲染 UTC。
- **缺陷 2**：`last N days/weeks` 腿用 `setDate(getDate() - n)`（本地算术）+ UTC 渲染 ⇒ 跨 DST 滑一小时。`month` / `year` 腿用 `setMonth` / `setFullYear`，同类。

⇒ 把 `setDate` 改成 `setUTCDate` **不会**修好缺陷 1。⛔ 验收时请分别确认。

## ⭐ 测试策略：卡给了一条很实在的提示，请照办

> ⛔ A regression test for the DST half **cannot** be written to run only at `TZ=UTC` —— the two spellings are **indistinguishable** there. **Defect 1, by contrast, is visible at any non-UTC zone without needing a transition instant**, so it is **the cheaper of the two to pin**。

⇒ **先钉缺陷 1**（任一非 UTC 时区即可复现，⛔ 不需要构造 DST 切换瞬间），再处理 DST 那半。

⚠️ **但卡指作"working model"的那个钉子今天不在树上** —— 实测（带活控制）：

```
被测：template-date-offset-dst.test.ts        → 全仓不存在
      （唯一含 "dst" 的路径是 spec/migrations/…/18.kernel__DistributedStateConfig.ts，
        是 **DistributedState** 的子串误配，⛔ 与本卡无关）
      setUTCDate|getUTCDate 在 packages/services/service-automation/  → 0 命中
控制：packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/ 下有 46 个 .test.ts（控制活）
```

⇒ **#14852 的修复与其钉子尚未合并**。⇒ 接手人若在 #14852 落地前开工，**照抄不到那个模型**，必须自己搭 DST 测试装置。⚠️ 这是本班次第 **7** 次「卡引用了只存在于自己分支上的东西」，已成模式。

⇒ **建议**：本卡与姊妹卡 #15824 都**等 #14852 落地后接手**，那时模型可抄、且三处修法拼写一致。⛔ 但本席不设 `pm:blocked` —— 缺陷本身在树上、修法不依赖 #14852，只是测试装置会更贵。

## 车道 `domain:engine`

落点 `packages/drivers/driver-memory/` ⇒ 车道表 `drivers/driver-*` 归 engine。

## ⚠️ 一个需要接手人自己定的问题（卡明确交给分诊/接手）

> Whether the right repair is a **spelling fix** or **replacing the parser** is a call for triage。

**分诊建议（⛔ 非裁决）**：先做**拼写修复**（UTC 化两个缺陷），⛔ 不要顺手换掉整个 parser。理由：换 parser 会把一个可精确验收的缺陷（两条测试即可钉死）变成一次行为面重写，而这个函数的**其余行为今天没有卡说它错**。⭐ 若认为该换，请**单独立卡**并先测量还有哪些 range 形式在用它。

Claim: session `session_01ARYe3yQTQCUFm5qPYNgKaJ`, branch `claude/issue-15825-memory-analytics-utc-window`.
Clause-②: no.

**Card-specific — two independent defects, one stale premise this seat has already re-measured, and one thing you must NOT do.**

⭐ **The two defects are INDEPENDENT. ⛔ Fixing one does not fix the other, and acceptance must confirm them separately.** The card says so twice and triage repeated it, so it is stated a third time here because it is the single easiest thing to get wrong on this card:
- **Defect 1 (the larger one)**: `new Date(y, m, d)` constructs **local** midnight; `toISOString()` then renders that instant in **UTC**. In any non-UTC process the `'today'` window is the local day expressed as a UTC range — `Asia/Shanghai` runs from the previous 16:00Z, `America/Los_Angeles` from 08:00Z. **Wrong every day of the year, ⛔ not only across DST.**
- **Defect 2**: the `last N days` / `last N weeks` legs use `setDate(getDate() - n)` (local arithmetic) rendered as UTC, so the window start slips an hour across a DST transition. The `month` / `year` legs use `setMonth` / `setFullYear` — same class.

⇒ Changing `setDate` to `setUTCDate` **leaves the local-midnight boundary in place**. ⇒ ⛔ Do not report "fixed" off one of the two.

⭐ **What makes this p2 is a platform inconsistency, not a boundary being a few hours off**: the rest of the platform resolves a bare date to the **UTC** day (`@objectstack/core`'s `{today}` macro falls back to UTC parts when the context carries no timezone; `{TODAY()}` in flow templates resolves to the UTC day). ⇒ **The same analytics question answered through this path and through a flow token can select different rows in the same deployment.** That is the property the fix has to restore, so UTC is the target calendar — ⛔ not "any consistent one".

⚠️ **The card's cited test model: triage measured it ABSENT, and this seat has since measured the blocking card CLOSED. ⛔ Neither reading is good enough for you — re-measure by content.** Triage (2026-09-05T10:34:27Z, with a live control) found `template-date-offset-dst.test.ts` **nowhere in the repo** and `setUTCDate|getUTCDate` at **0 hits** in `packages/services/service-automation/`, because #14852's fix had not merged; on that basis it advised waiting. This seat then read #14852 as `state=closed, state_reason=completed` (2026-09-05T20:47Z). ⛔ **That is an API state read, and this loop does not accept the API's word for a landing** — verify by **content on `origin/main`** whether that file and that spelling are on the tree, **with a firing positive control**, before you rely on it as a model. If it is absent, build your own DST fixture and say so; if it is present, copy its spelling so the three sites agree.

⛔ **Spelling fix only. Do NOT replace the parser.** The card hands that choice to triage and triage ruled it: *"先做拼写修复（UTC 化两个缺陷），⛔ 不要顺手换掉整个 parser"* — replacing it turns a defect with two precise acceptance tests into a behaviour-surface rewrite, and **nothing on the tree says the function's other behaviour is wrong**. If you conclude it should be replaced, ⛔ do not do it here: file a separate card and **first measure which `range` forms actually reach it**.

⚠️ **The function's own disclaimer is not an exemption.** It carries `// In production, this would use a proper date range parser`. It is nevertheless **live**: reached from the analytics query path (the card anchors the call at `memory-analytics.ts:742`, the function at `:1415`). ⛔ Re-derive both — these are the card's numbers and this repo's files move daily. Code that is still answering a user's question has to answer correctly, disclaimer or not.

**Test strategy (triage's, and it is the cheap order)**: pin **defect 1 first** — visible at *any* non-UTC zone with **no transition instant needed**. ⛔ A regression test for the **DST half cannot be written to run only at `TZ=UTC`** — the two spellings are indistinguishable there, so a `TZ=UTC`-only test is an assertion that compares nothing.

**Clause-② reading (this seat's, not binding)**: `no` — `parseDateRangeString` is a private method of `driver-memory`; what moves is an answer, not a published surface, and the 2026-08-28 boundary ruling is explicit that 「条款②只指已发布契约面」. ⭐ Re-measure with the `dist/index.d.ts` ablation anyway.

⚠️ **This `Clause-②` reading is this seat's and is NOT binding on you.** Re-derive it from your own diff and re-declare it in your report. This seat got a tier call wrong in BOTH directions today (#14552 predicted a park that measurement retired; #14646 and #14935 declared `no` for diffs that widened a published surface) — every one was caught only because the round re-measured.

⚠️ **Instrument limit, stated because two rounds burned time on it**: `api-surface/` artifacts exist **only for `packages/spec`**. For any other package the published surface is its `files[]` + `types` (`dist/**`). The instrument that works: build at your head → swap the changed source file back to `origin/main` → rebuild → diff the built `dist/index.d.ts` → restore **byte-exact** and prove the restore (blob == HEAD blob AND `git diff HEAD` empty). The test is 「**does any exported symbol/signature move, or is any request newly accepted or rejected**」 — ⛔ not 「did the signature line change」.

✅ **The Corepack CI defect is FIXED.** `check-regen-pending.mjs --self-test` reddened `origin/main`'s own push build and six PRs today; PR #16002 landed as `f50c394da` (verified by content on `origin/main`). If you cut from current `main` you will not see it. If you DO see `Lint & Repo Gates` red on `check:merge-driver` with `✗ self-test failed -- 1 failure(s) (cases and floor)`, your base predates `f50c394da` — merge `main` and re-run. ⛔ Do not skip, disable or quarantine anything over it.

⭐ **Discipline notes earned the hard way today, all from real failures:**
1. **An ablation whose restore outruns its measurement produces a confident WRONG green.** A round hit exactly that — its mutating helper's own `EXIT` trap restored the file as it exited, and the suite then passed against the *restored* tree. Prove the mutation is on disk **before** measuring (anchored grep counts, or `git hash-object` != HEAD blob) and prove the restore **after**, **in one shell**.
2. **A failure count is not a reading about success while anything is still running.** Read `status` explicitly. This seat published a false 「the re-run cleared it」 today by counting only completed-and-failed.
3. **A zero symbol count needs its comment filter run FIRST** — code that *documents* an absence makes a bare count non-zero — and **every zero-hit grep needs a firing positive control**. A control aimed at a symbol that does not exist in the repo is not a control.
4. **`cancelled` is not `failed`.** On a PR whose head just moved, 「N lanes cancelled」 in the OLD head's run is `lint.yml`'s `concurrency: cancel-in-progress`, not evidence about that head. Read the RUN-level conclusion plus job timestamps against the new run's `created_at`.
5. **The shared verify lock is contended.** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` returning **exit 99 is a timeout = NO READING**, ⛔ not a green and ⛔ not a red. Re-run to a real result and say so. Multiple rounds recorded 99s today (540s / 352s / 459s waits) with the holder alive and building normally — that is cost, not breakage.
6. **Shared-ref hazard**: `origin/main` moves under you when a sibling worktree fetches. Pin every diff and merge to a **sha**, never to the ref name. One round read 9 changed files that were really 5.

⛔ **Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`** in a code PR — release notes are written centrally at release time. Your PR's input to them is its **changeset**. E3 (2026-09-05) 「已发布必修，其余立卡」 — "published" is a MEASUREMENT against built `dist/**/*.d.ts`, `dist/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs}` and `content/docs/**`, not a guess.

⛔ **Worktree-first** (one dedicated worktree, this repo AND any sibling you touch) and ⛔ **never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` lives in the common `.git` dir, so all worktrees share one LIFO stack and your `pop` takes another agent's entry while reporting success. Use a patch file or a wip commit. ⛔ Never force-push or rebase a pushed branch.

**Bump level**: additive widening of a published surface ⇒ at least `minor`. ⭐ **The act wins over the commit type** — the gate at `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` only refuses `major`, so it will not catch a `patch` that should have been `minor`.

I hand-read all six candidates. **Verdict: zero pages are falsified**, so under E3 there is nothing to repair in this PR — and per the instruction I did ⛔ not widen it.

**1. `data-modeling/queries.mdx` — the one page that does state a calendar, and it states UTC.** Two rules, neither falsified:

- `:83` — "`date` … Timezone-naive calendar day. A `Date` collapses to its **UTC** day."
- `:668-672` — "Buckets are computed in **UTC** … a query sent over REST always buckets on UTC calendar boundaries."

⭐ This is the opposite of drift: before this fix the driver's `'today'` window **disagreed** with the rule this page states, in every non-UTC process.
